patch_description: Combine the tighter contraction threshold at smaller default radii with the broader threshold at larger radii. The tighter parent improved case_001 error from 3.371 to 2.874; the broader parent improved case_010 from 5.769 to 5.193 and interval-end error from 3.442 to 2.741. Executed distributions confirm both parents used three and four relocations, with the broader threshold generally increasing four-count responses. Retain their shared loss-versus-improvement condition. This tests whether the useful contraction threshold depends on the public radius scale; improved aggregate performance remains unmeasured.
